facts.value: These courses aim to impart communicative and intercultural foreign language skills, refresh and complete existing basic knowledge of the English language, and provide insight into specific vocabulary as well as general aspects of the economy in English-speaking countries.
B1.2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages
Completion of level A2/B1 of the GER or 26 – 40 points in the placement test.

In the Business English Foundation course, students learn vocabulary and expressions specific to the business world. A variety of exercises aim to promote both linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and form the basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects. The reading and writing component will be assessed in a 90-minute written exam during the last week of the semester. A graded certificate will be issued for passing the exam.
90 Euro for 13 double hours, including final exam.
